title: Light Presets
description:
One-click lighting presets in the scene lighting toolbar, working exactly like the core wall type buttons: pick a preset, then drag to place. Presets are grouped by theme behind a few toolbar buttons, the active preset shows an indicator pip, and your choice persists between sessions.

Each preset fully specifies its light configuration, so switching never inherits leftover values, and bright/dim behaviour is applied live in the drag preview — what you see while dragging is what you get.

Built on the V14 placeable palette system: system-agnostic, no dependencies, no external assets.
